mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 0.5% correlates with negative 20-day returns in >50% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 5.0% coincides with negative 5-day returns in >50% of instances or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates sectoral supply shocks that trigger policy responses and sector rotation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline + HOUST increase fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >60% of cases or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: High consumer credit growth (RSAFS above 75th percentile) fuels consumption-driven corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days during expansionary demand regimes.
failure_condition: RSAFS above 75th percentile correlates with negative 60-day returns in >50% of cases or Rank IC < 0.04 over 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL annualized inflation exceeding 2.5% signals accelerating price pressures that prompt monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL inflation > 2.5% coincides with positive 20-day returns in >50% of cases or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive month-over-month employment growth (PAYEMS) consistently supports consumer spending and equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth correlates with negative 20-day returns in >50% of cases or Rank IC < 0.04 over 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in consumer credit (RSAFS) and decline in housing starts (HOUST) indicates consumption reallocation toward non-housing sectors, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: RSAFS increase + HOUST decline fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >60% of cases or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals recessionary supply-labor conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline + UNRATE rise correlates with positive 20-day returns in >50% of cases or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.
